business_problem: Fragmented ecommerce and business data, expensive cloud operations, and rising security requirements limited Simba's ability to forecast accurately and respond quickly across its supply chain and customer experience teams.
solution_summary: Simba Sleep redesigned its analytics stack around Snowflake so CRM, sales, marketing, product, and operational data could live in one cloud-native lake rather than fragmented point solutions. Fivetran ingests data from business systems, dbt Cloud shapes it, and Power BI serves reporting on top of Snowflake, giving leadership and product teams a governed view of customer behavior, supply-chain issues, and forecasting signals. Structured and semi-structured data from multiple regions now lands in the same platform, supporting faster root-cause analysis on product or delivery issues and quicker response when tickets indicate a problem. Because Snowflake's storage and compute scale independently, Simba absorbed growth and peak demand without spiraling cost. Snowflake's security controls and responsive support also helped enable SSO and satisfy GDPR-oriented expansion requirements, creating a durable platform for real-time reporting and future sustainability analytics.

solution_components.name: Fivetran
solution_components.role: Ingests business-system data into Simba's centralized Snowflake environment.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Stores Simba's unified CRM, sales, marketing, product, and operations data in one governed platform.

solution_components.name: dbt Cloud
solution_components.role: Transforms raw business data into modeled datasets for operational reporting and analysis.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Serves near-real-time reports and dashboards for business, product, and operational teams.

data_flow: CRM, sales, marketing, product, and support data is ingested through Fivetran into Snowflake, transformed with dbt Cloud, and exposed through Power BI. The shared lake lets Simba trace customer and supply-chain issues quickly and deliver near-real-time reporting across regions.
business_outcome: Simba deployed Snowflake in three months, reduced processing time by 75%, made reporting near real time, strengthened security, and created a single business view that helps teams improve products, service, and forecasting.
